capabilities: show backlinks as tag-like links in the note footer
show outlinks in the footer (disabled by default)
display created and modified dates per note
extras: README includes a tip request to support the author's work.
intentEvidence: enhances the footer of your notes by adding backlinks, outlinks, and created/modified dates
problem: Obsidian's backlinks and outgoing links live in side panels, and file dates are not shown on the note itself.
summary: Footer display plugin that adds backlinks, outlinks, and created/modified dates as tag-style links to the bottom of notes.
